usedFor: Google Ads is where your lead forms get filled in, and HubSpot is where the sales pipeline lives. “New Lead Form Submitted” in Google Ads can open a “Create Deal” in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Form Submitted” in Google Ads, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Google Ads pushes the form submission as it happens, and “Create Deal” puts that lead into the pipeline. The other actions edit records that already exist, which a brand new lead does not have yet.

watchOut: “Update Deal” and “Update Company” need the ID of an existing record, and “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email. A fresh ad lead has none of these, so start with “Create Deal”.
